cv.name: Ingrid van der Wal
cv.headline: Senior Registered Nurse – Intensive Care | BIG-registered
cv.summary: BIG-registered intensive care nurse with ten years of clinical experience in academic and teaching hospitals. I combine bedside care with a coordinating role on the unit, mentor student nurses and lead the unit's work on delirium prevention.

experience.title: Senior IC Nurse / Shift Coordinator
bullets: Coordinate shifts on a 24-bed mixed ICU and allocate patients across a team of up to 14 nurses
Lead the delirium prevention working group; screening compliance rose from 60% to 92%
Mentor student nurses and newly qualified IC nurses during their training
Care for ventilated patients, CRRT and post-cardiac surgery patients

experience.title: IC Nurse
bullets: Provided intensive care nursing and took part in the rapid response team
Supported the introduction of a new patient data management system

experience.title: Registered Nurse, Surgical Ward
bullets: Delivered pre- and post-operative care on a 30-bed general surgery ward
